items.text: Kaberuroik che biitu amu kasetab it
Ak ngiepchi it kutitab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’ eng’ kagiiletab ge, irib iyai ng’atutikyik tugul che kaang’atin rani, koeetin anyun Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’ isiir bororiosiek tugul che mi ng’ony:
ak kobwanjinin kaberurosiechu tugul, koityin, ngiepchi it kutitab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’.
Kiberurin eng’ nganaset, kiberurin eng’ mbar.
Kiberuri iyoteng’ung’, ak iyotetab emeng’ung’, ak iyotetab akwotisieguk ak ne bo tuguk ak arekab kechireguk.
Kiberuri kitongeng’ung’ ak tereng’ung’ ne kitangware busiek.
Kiberurin ye imong’u, ak kiberurin ye imandoi sang’.
Igoitoi Jehovah buniguk che ng’eetyinin kiterter eng’ taing’ung’: ibokyinin eng’ oret agenge, ago mwee ortinwek tisab eng’ taing’ung’.
Ng’atei Jehovah berurto konyonjin, eng’ chogeniguk ak eng’ tugul che iyai eng’ eung’ung’; ak iberurin eng’ emet ne konin Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’.
Ak kogimitin Jehovah iegu bororiennyi ne tilil, ko u ye kiiyosieun; ngirib ng’atutikab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’, iwendote ortinwekyik.
Ak kogeer bororiosiek tugul che bo ng’ony kole kiguurtoenen kainetab Jehovah; ak koiywein.
Ak koyabin Jehovah ibaraitu iegu ne nyiitat mieindo, eng’ iyoteng’ung’, ak eng’ iyotetab akwotisieguk, ak eng’ iyotetab koreng’ung’, eng’ emet ne kiiyosiechi Jehovah kwanisieguk kole konin.
Yatun Jehovah konoruennyi ne kararan noto ko kipsengwet korobonji emeng’ung’ eng’ betusiekyik, ak koberur boisionik tugul che bo euneguk: ak ibesendochi bororiosiek che chang’, ago mebeseni.
Yain Jehovah iegu metit ago meegu katutiet; ak iegu ne mi barak kityo, ago meegu ne mi ng’ony; ngiepchi it ng’atutikab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’, che ang’atin rani, irib ak iyai;
ngo meistoege ng’olyo age tugul ne ang’atin rani, iwe tai anan katam, isub kanamonik iot.
Chubisiosiek che biitu amu bistoet
Ago ngo meepchi it kutitab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’, irib iyai ng’atutikyik tugul ak konetisiosiekyik che ang’atin rani; kobwanjin koityin anyun chubisiosiechu tugul.
Kichubin eng’ nganaset, ak kichubin eng’ mbar.
Kichubei kitongeng’ung’ ak tereng’ung’ ne kitangware busiek.
Kichubei iyoteng’ung’, ak iyotetab emeng’ung’, ak ne bo tuguk ak arekab kechireguk.
Kichubin ye imong’u, ak kichubin ye imandoi sang’.
Iyogun Jehovah chubisiet ak nyalilda, ak keretab kong’, eng’ tugul che iyae euneguk, agoi kong’emin, ak agoi ilus ichakte; amu yaitietab boisioniguk ne kigonin ibagakta.
Konin Jehovah koroito konamin agoi kowong’un eng’ emet ne iwendi iname kobunjin.
Birin Jehovah eng’ chebuonit, ak mat ne mi borto, ak kabwanet, ak mat ne ng’wan, ak rotwetab chok, ak chelalitiet, ak uchatet: onotin choto agoi ilus.
Ak egu sugunwet kipsengwet ne mi baragung’ung’, ak koek karnet ng’ony ne itieche.
Yaei Jehovah roptab emeng’ung’ koek temburiek ak ng’ung’unyek: chorjiningei choto eng’ kipsengwet, agoi igesuge.
Igoitoin Jehovah koterterin buniguk: ibokyini eng’ oret agenge, ak imwee eng’ tainywa eng’ ortinwek tisab: ak koonatin bororiosiek tugul che bo ng’ony.
Ak koek mustang’ung’ amditab taritik tugul che bo barak, ak tiong’ik che bo ng’ony, ak mabiitu chi ne iyestoi.
Birenen Jehovah ondirik che bo Misri, ak kabwondo, ak kochek, ak simbiriek, che magimuchi kisoobun.
Birenen Jehovah iywek, ak koratet, ak kaiyweisiet ne bo muguleldo:
iwendi isabsabisioti bet kwen, ko u ye sabsabisioti kipkoratiat eng’ mesundeito, ama kiberurin eng’ ortinweguk: ak kinyalilin kityo ak kerebenen tuguguk kotugul, ama biitu ne sorun.
Ituni osotiot, ak koipgei ak chito age: iteeche got, amemenye: imine mbaretab sabibuk, amebute logoekwak.
Kienyei eitang’ung’ igeere, ameame banyekyik: kirebenen sigirieng’ung’ eng’ koromnatet, igeere, ama kiweegun: kigochin kechireguk buniguk, ama biitu chi ne sorun.
Kigochin bororiet age weriguk ak tibiguk, ak keerei konyeguk ak koamjin emo ichek betut komugul: ametinye kimnatet eng’ eung’ung’.
Amei bororiet ne mengen logoekab emeng’ung’, ak boisioniguk tugul; kinyalilin ak ketiekyinin ng’ony kotugul:
agoi koamin iywek amu tugul che igeere eng’ konyeguk.
Birei Jehovah kutung’oiguk, ak kelyeguk, eng’ ondirik che ng’wonen, che magimuchi kisoobun, koboch keldebesiet agoi metit barak.
Imutin Jehovah koboto laitoriandeng’ung’ ne tun indoi koboun, agoi iit bororiet ne mengen, inye, anan kwanisieguk; ak iot kanamonik eng’ oloto, che bo ketik ak koik.
Ak iegu kwong’utiet, ak kalewenet, ak atindiot, eng’ kwenutab bik tugul ole imutyinin Jehovah.
Iibe keswek che chang’ mbar, ago igese che ng’ering’; amu tarei chereng’endet.
Imine mbarenikab sabibuk ak isemberi, ago mee divaikyik, anan ibut logoek; amu amei kutik.
Itinye emitik eng’ kiwotosieguk tugul, ago meilege mwanikwak; amu iroroi logoekwak che bo emitiguk.
Isiche werik ak tibik, ago maegu cheguk; amu kiluulei.
Bunjin chereng’endet ketiguk tugul ak ruratetab emeng’ung’.
Tororitu toondet ne mi kwenung’ung’ kosiirin; ak iming’initu mising’.
Besendoun inendet, ago mebesendochini: egu inendet metit, ak iegu katutiet.
Ak kobwanjin chubisiosiechu tugul, koonatin, agoi konamin, agoi kong’emin; amu ma iepchi it kutitab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’, irib ng’atutikyik ak konetisiosiekyik che king’atin:
ak kotebenen choto koek kaborunet ak kwong’utiet, ak kotebe iyoteng’ung’ agoi koigeny.
Amu meboisiechini Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’ eng’ boiboindo, ak eng’ kagesetab ge ne bo muguleldo, amu chang’indab tuguk tugul:
iote anyun buniguk che imutun Jehovah kong’eetyin, eng’ rubet, ak eng’ melelda, ak eng’ ach ngorit, ak eng’ rarunetab tuguk tugul: ak konde chogitab karnet kaating’ung’, agoi kobarin.
Imutun Jehovah bororiet konyo koborienen ne bunu ole loo, tabandab ng’ony, ko u ye tirireni kipsichit; bororiet ne megase ng’alekwak;
bororiet ne korom igeere, ne meiiti chi ne os, ama rire lakwa:
ak koam iyotetab tuguk, ak ruratetab emeng’ung’, agoi kowong’un: ne mabagagun bek, anan divaik, anan mwanik, anan iyotetab tuguk, anan arekab kechireguk, agoi kolusin.

Ak koyiemin eng’ kurgotiguk tugul, agoi kolulyo irimoiguk che koen, che ng’ototin, che imang’u, eng’ emeng’ung’ komugul: yiemin eng’ kurgotiguk tugul eng’ emeng’ung’ komugul, ne kigogonin Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’.
Ak iam iyoteng’ung’ banyekab weriguk ak tibiguk che kigonin Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’; ye kagoyiemin buniguk, ak eng’ bichiindo ne ibun buniguk.
Ak kogeere kong’ ne ya chito ne ko kiptalbisio ak ko ng’arng’arge ne mi kwenung’wong’, ng’etab kamet ak osotiondennyi ne chamei, ak lagokyik che kang’et:
kot ko macham kobutyi chi age tugul eng’ ichek banyekab lagokyik che amei, amu mang’etyi kiy inendet; amu yiemet ak amu bichiindo ne ibun buniguk eng’ kurgotiguk tugul.

Ak kogeere kong’ ne ya kwondo ne mi kwenung’wong’ ne cheptalbisio ak ko ng’arng’ar ne machamei kotiegat ng’ony amu talbistanyi ak ng’arng’arindo, manong’otiondennyi ne chamei, ak eng’ werinnyi, ak eng’ cheptanyi;
ak eng’ sindariet ne sichei inendet, ak eng’ lagokyik che sichei; amei eng’ ung’ot amu bananda: eng’ kamuutetab nganaset ak eng’ rubet amu keret ne kerei kurgotiguk buniguk.
Ngo merib iyai ng’alek tugul che bo ng’atutioni che kigisirji bukuini, si kobiit igonyit kainani bo teegisto, kainet ne kiywei JEHOVAH KAMUKTAINDENG’UNG’;
koyai anyun Jehovah korotweguk koek che kikwong’e, ak korotwekab iyoteng’ung’, korotwek che eechen, che tebyei keny, ak mianwek che yaachen, che tebyei keny.
Ak koweekyin mianwek tugul che bo Misri, che kiiywei; ak konamin.
Kogeny ibun Jehovah miando age tugul, ak koroito age tugul, ne ma kisirji bukuitab ng’atutioni, agoi kiwong’un.
Ak ong’etu che ng’ering’, che ki aechin chang’indang’wong’ ak kecheikab kipsengwetisiek; amu kima iepchi it kutitab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’ung’.
Ak ko u ye kibaibait Jehovah eng’ okwek koyaiywok ne mie, ak kotesak; u noto boiboitu Jehovah eng’ okwek kolusak, ak kowong’wok; ak kitutok eng’ emet ne iwendi iname kobunjin.
Ak koiyestak Jehovah obe bororiosiek tugul, koboch tabanda age ne bo ng’ony agoi tabanda age; ak iot kanamonik eng’ oloto che bo ketik ak che bo koik, che mengen, inye, anan kwanisieguk.
Amenyoru kamuung’et eng’ bororiosiechoto, menyoru ole imuung’e keldang’ung’: ago konin Jehovah eng’ oloto muguleldo ne rugrugeni, ak konyek che kortos, ak muguleldo ne ichuchui:
amenai ole teptoi sobeng’ung’; ak iyweisiei kemoi ak bet, ak menae ole itei sobondang’ung’:
Ilen karon, Kata kaigai nda ka koskoleny nguno! Ak ile koskoleny, Kata kaigai nda kaeech! Amu kaiyweisietab muguleldang’ung’ ne iyweisiei, ak amu tuguk che keerei konyeguk che tun igeere.
Ak koweekyin Jehovah Misri kogeny eng’ melisiek, eng’ oret ne kiamwaun, ale, Ma igeere kogeny: ak oaldochige bunikwok eng’ oloto oegu otwogik che murenik ak che kobogorisiek, ago mabiitu chi ne alok.
